name: nano-banana-2
description: Local Gemini image-generation CLI and review workbench with durable prompt lineage, style comparison, cost tracking, and production export.

scripts.build: rm -rf dist && bun build src/cli.ts --target=bun --outdir=dist && cp -R web recipes package.json dist/
scripts.check: bun run format:check && bun run lint && bun run typecheck && bun test && bun run build && bun run test:built
